description: Zener Diode Independent 12V 350mW Surface Mount SOD-123
designVerdict: SELECTED - Vgs clamp, one per channel load switch
notes: BZT52C12, 12 V Zener, SOD-123, 552k stock, $0.017. One per channel switch.

Limits Vgs on the TM40P06D, whose maximum is +/-20 V. The exact clamp depends on the gate network values, which are not yet derived - and note the Zener will run far below its 5 mA test current in any high-impedance network, so the clamp sits nearer 10-11 V than 12 V. That still clears the 10 V at which the FET's 23 mOhm is specified.
